# Local vs. Global Digital Marketing Strategies Explored

by

[AD GUYS & CO](https://adguysco.com/blog/author/AD%20GUYS%20&%20CO)

in [Digital Marketing](https://adguysco.com/blog/category/Digital-Marketing) Posted on

In the ever-evolving realm of [digital marketing](https://adguysco.com/), businesses are faced with a pivotal decision: should they enlist the services of a local agency or opt for a global one? This question holds particular significance in a vibrant metropolis like Singapore, where the blend of cultures and rapid technological advancements creates a unique landscape for marketing endeavors. Join us as we delve into the intricacies of local versus global digital marketing strategies, examining the approaches taken by Singaporean agencies against their international counterparts.

  

Understanding the Local Terrain: Singaporean Agencies

  

[Singaporean digital marketing agencies](https://adguysco.com/) possess an intimate understanding of the local market dynamics, cultural nuances, and consumer behavior. This familiarity grants them a competitive edge when crafting tailor-made strategies that resonate with the Singaporean audience. With a finger on the pulse of local trends and preferences, these agencies can swiftly adapt campaigns to capitalize on emerging opportunities.

  

Cultural Sensitivity: Singapore's multicultural fabric demands a nuanced approach to marketing. Local agencies are adept at navigating the diverse cultural landscape, ensuring that campaigns are culturally sensitive and resonate with the target audience. From understanding festive traditions to linguistic nuances, these agencies excel in crafting messages that strike a chord with Singaporean consumers.

  

Hyper-local Targeting: One of the key strengths of local agencies lies in their ability to execute hyper-local targeting strategies. Leveraging geolocation data and demographic insights, these agencies can pinpoint specific neighborhoods or districts, allowing businesses to reach potential customers with precision. Whether it's promoting a neighborhood cafe in Tiong Bahru or a boutique store in Bugis, local agencies excel in delivering targeted messages to the right audience at the right time.

  

Community Engagement: Building a strong sense of community is paramount in Singapore's tightly-knit society. Local agencies excel in fostering community engagement through localized content, events, and partnerships. By tapping into local influencers or sponsoring community initiatives, businesses can cultivate brand loyalty and establish themselves as integral members of the community.

  

Casting a Global Net: International Agencies

  

On the flip side, international digital marketing agencies bring a wealth of experience, resources, and global perspectives to the table. While they may lack the intimate knowledge of the local market, they compensate with broader reach, cutting-edge technology, and innovative strategies honed on a global scale.

  

Scale and Scope: International agencies boast extensive resources and a vast network of talent spread across the globe. This enables them to execute large-scale campaigns spanning multiple markets, leveraging economies of scale to drive efficiency and effectiveness. From multinational corporations to ambitious startups eyeing global expansion, these agencies cater to clients with diverse needs and aspirations.

  

Innovative Technologies: Staying ahead of the curve in the digital landscape requires access to cutting-edge technologies and tools. International agencies invest heavily in research and development, leveraging AI, machine learning, and data analytics to optimize campaigns and deliver measurable results. From predictive modeling to real-time analytics, these agencies harness the power of technology to drive performance and ROI.

  

Cross-cultural Expertise: While international agencies may lack the localized insights of their Singaporean counterparts, they bring valuable cross-cultural expertise to the table. Drawing on experience from diverse markets around the world, these agencies offer fresh perspectives and innovative solutions that transcend geographical boundaries. By tapping into global trends and consumer insights, businesses can gain a competitive edge in the Singaporean market and beyond.

  

The Verdict: Finding the Right Fit

  

In the battle between local vs. global digital marketing strategies, there is no one-size-fits-all solution. The choice ultimately boils down to the unique needs, goals, and budget constraints of each business. While Singaporean agencies excel in local expertise and community engagement, international agencies offer scalability, innovation, and global reach.

  

Finding Common Ground: In an increasingly interconnected world, the lines between local and global are becoming increasingly blurred. Many businesses opt for a hybrid approach, leveraging the strengths of both local and international agencies to craft holistic marketing strategies that resonate with local audiences while tapping into global trends and best practices.

  

Collaboration is Key: Regardless of whether you choose a local or global agency, collaboration is key to success. By fostering open communication, aligning goals, and sharing insights, businesses can harness the collective expertise of their agency partners to drive growth, innovation, and long-term success in the dynamic landscape of digital marketing.

  

In conclusion, the choice between local and global [digital marketing agencies](https://adguysco.com/) is not a binary one but rather a spectrum of possibilities. By carefully evaluating the strengths, weaknesses, and unique value propositions of each option, businesses can make informed decisions that pave the way for success in the digital age. # The Ultimate Guide To Digital Marketing Success in 2023

*    ![Picture of Donald Chan](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/2332d5784fed2f6195d50a96642136d654ad7b2a3e541fc5137be963efc5e509?s=96&d=mm&r=g)By Donald Chan

*   January 2, 2021
*   , Digital Marketing

As 2023 approaches, marketing teams across Singapore are gearing up to chart their course for the upcoming year. However, in the midst of an ever-evolving digital marketing landscape, staying abreast of emerging technologies and platform advancements can be quite a demanding task. Being a [digital marketing agency in Singapore](https://www.impactbc.com.sg/) adds an extra layer of complexity to the already time-consuming experienc

While many know that digital marketing is a must in their planning, just what are the areas they need to focus on to ensure success? To help marketers everywhere, we’ve distilled eight critical steps you need to take to bring about digital marketing success in 2023. There are also additional online resources to get more in-depth knowledge on specific areas too.

Let’s take a look!

### **1) Knowing Which Strategies Fit Your Business**

Digital marketing success starts with understanding which strategies and platforms are a right fit for your business, product and service. By focusing your time and resources on improving the right areas, you’ll be on the way to achieving better results.

For B2B marketers concerned with [lead generation](https://hunter.io/blog/b2b-lead-generation-strategies/) and conversion, digital marketing strategies can be applied at each stage of the [sales funnel](https://blog.salesflare.com/sales-pipeline), from increasing the number of qualified leads (SEM, content marketing, [email databases](https://contactout.com/), [LinkedIn marketing](https://www.impactbc.com.sg/services/linkedin-marketing/)), nurturing them (webinars, white papers), right up to conversion (retargeting, marketing automation).

For B2C marketers, social media and blogging are great ways to build brand engagement online. But you’ll need to develop a strong content strategy to continually keep your brand relevant and interesting to consumers, across all the media platforms they’re on.

Find Out More On: [Choosing The Right Digital Marketing Model](http://www.strategy-business.com/article/00241?gko=20aae), [Lead Generation for B2B Marketers](https://albacross.com/newsroom/b2b-lead-generation-strategies/)

### **2) Measure Everything So You Know What’s Working, What’s Not** 

They say if you don’t track and measure your digital marketing efforts, you might as well be flying blind. After all, you wouldn’t be able to tell which part of your digital marketing is working (or not). A good place to begin would be to look at your website statistics. For that, there’s Google Analytics and [Google Tag Manager](https://www.adscelerate.com/google-tag-manager-guide/), which are both free services from Google and easy to install and use.

Once set up, you can start looking into your web traffic and figuring out what needs to be improved through UTM codes. These codes are additional text you add to a link, which allows Google Analytics to tell the source of traffic, as well as attributes such as which campaign, medium and keywords targeted). You can use Google’s [URL builder tool](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/1033867?hl=en) to create your own UTM codes.

Finally, with sufficient data in place, you can start making sense of your digital marketing efforts. Some of the more basic metrics include page views, unique visitors, click-through rates, cost per clicks and conversion rates. Once you’re comfortable with them, you can advance to more advanced metrics such as cost per acquisition.

Learn More: [The Basics of Google Analytics](http://www.socialmediaexaminer.com/google-analytics-basics/), [What Are UTM codes?](https://blog.bufferapp.com/utm-guide), [Key Metrics To Track & Measure](http://www.forbes.com/sites/jaysondemers/2014/08/15/10-online-marketing-metrics-you-need-to-be-measuring/)

### **3) It’s Not Too Late To Have A Content Marketing Plan** 

While research has shown that content marketing is highly effective in driving marketing results across B2B and B2C segments, there are still many marketers in Singapore who have yet to seriously embrace content as a part of their planning.

Much of this stems from misunderstandings on what content marketing is, how much it costs and just what kind of results it can bring. There are also marketers that are unsure just how to go about with their content marketing strategy.

But with traditional advertising and promotional tactics losing traction in a digital world, it’s important for marketers to just take a first step – any step – to get going on digital content marketing. For those who need a bit more help, there are many useful online resources for you to step up your content marketing game.

Learn More: [Getting Started With Content Marketing](https://moz.com/beginners-guide-to-content-marketing), [Social Media Marketing Tips](https://www.socialpilot.co/blog/social-media-marketing-tips) ,[Creative Infographics](https://venngage.com/blog/creative-infographics/)

### **4) Invest in Marketing Automation To Build Conversations**

For many businesses, their websites are largely glorified brochures. However, by introducing [marketing technology](https://martechwise.com/marketing-technology-martech/) and [sales automation tools](https://www.uplead.com/sales-automation-tools/), it’s possible for brands to build meaningful conversations with prospects and customers instead, thereby increasing engagement.

Some of the more common marketing automation softwares out there in the market include [HubSpot](https://www.impactbc.com.sg/services/hubspot-partner/), Marketo, Eloqua and SharpSpring. But, whichever solution you choose, they should include tools such as web visitor identification and analytics, lead scoring, behaviour tracking, email automation and dynamic forms.

![SharpSpring](https://ptf2go.serveravatartmp.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/SharpSpring.jpg)

SharpSpring Marketing Automation

Done right, marketing automation can follow potential customers throughout the buyer decision cycle, delivering the right message through email at the right time. For B2B prospects, this is important given the high involvement for products and services.

Learn More: [Guide To Marketing Automation](https://www.quicksprout.com/the-definitive-guide-to-marketing-automation-chapter-1/), [Lead Generation Tools](https://aeroleads.com/blog/lead-generation-tools/)

# A Guide To Facebook Advertising: How To Get Started

*   [Home](https://www.impossible.sg/) / Articles / A Guide To…

[Nadiah Nizom](https://www.impossible.sg/author/writer/) [Articles](https://www.impossible.sg/category/articles/), [Digital Marketing](https://www.impossible.sg/category/digital-marketing/), [Social Media Hub – Blogs, Tips & Growth Strategies](https://www.impossible.sg/category/social-media-marketing-smm/)

### A Guide To Facebook Advertising: How To Get Started

Posted on: February 25, 2022

Facebook is one of the most used applications in the world right now, offering unique and vast opportunities for businesses to boost their [digital marketing](https://www.impossible.sg/ "Digital Marketing Singapore, Digital Marketing Agency Singapore") efforts. Are you reaching the right targeted audience? Is your image scaled to the proper dimension? These are some of the questions you need to ask yourself when creating a Facebook ad.

To do so, we have compiled a comprehensive guide and checklist to ensure your business gets everything in place for a successful marketing campaign.

Facebook provides several types of ads and placements. However, all options can be grouped into three categories:

**1) Campaigns:** The main theme of your marketing campaign.  
**2) Ad sets:** The different groups of advertising required if you are targeting different aspects of audiences.  
**3) Ads:** The actual paid ads within the specific ad sets.

Understanding the key terms that you might come across when first starting out, we can now dive into how to start running Facebook advertising in Singapore.

### 1\. Create a Facebook ads manager account

Facebook ads manager is a tool that allows users a seamless overview of their completed and ongoing campaigns. It shows how much your business is spending each day on current campaigns and key results such as frequency and reach. Essentially, it provides users with an easier marketing performance report. Once you have properly set up your ads manager account, it becomes the main base of your advertising needs.

### 2\. Choose an objective

Like any social media network, Facebook ads manager too is curated specifically towards the campaign’s objective. When you create an ad, the first thing that the ad manager will prompt you to select is the objective of your campaign:

*   Brand awareness
*   Increase traffic
*   Lead generation
*   Conversions
*   Sales

### 3\. Choose your audience

Facebook ads manager has an audience definition gauge to show you the audience reach of your campaign. It takes into consideration your selected audience properties to give you an estimated potential reach figure. The audience definition gauge is split between specific, balanced, and broad.

Do consider your campaign’s objective when deciding the reach capacity. If you are a new business looking to build awareness, then reaching a broader audience might benefit. However, if you are looking to boost sales or increase website traffic, then you might want your campaign to target a specific audience.

### 4\. Budget

There are two budget options that Facebook offers.

*   **Daily budget:** Using this option means that Facebook will adjust your daily spending. This is recommended if you want your ad set to run all day long.
*   **Lifetime budget:**For ad campaigns running for a certain duration, this would be recommended. Instead of adjusting according to daily spending, Facebook will pace how much you spend over the set period.

You can further customise your [Facebook campaign budget](https://www.impossible.sg/maximising-your-facebook-campaign-budget-with-cost-control/ "Maximising Your Facebook Campaign Budget With Cost Control") by setting a set schedule, accelerating your delivery, or bidding for optimised reach – coming up with a Facebook advertising cost that you and your team are comfortable with.

### 5\. Monitor ad’s performance

Once you have created your ad and have commenced the campaign, it is always essential to keep an eye on its performance. Facebook ads manager or a personal marketing software is two key ways to do so. Either way, you can monitor your campaign in four levels:

*   **Account Level:** An overview of the performance across all your campaigns. Go to account overview on your ads manager, and you can see the general data of your campaigns.
*   **Campaign, ad set or specific ad:** You can dive into either the specific campaign to see how the specific campaign is performing or if there are several ads set within the campaign. You can do so by selecting the specific tab within the account overview.

### Conclusion

Facebook advertising is not difficult if you follow these simple steps. As mentioned earlier, Facebook is one of the most used apps in the world, which means that the benefits of running Facebook ads are limitless. If you are looking to utilise Facebook ads in your marketing campaigns but still do not know where to start or wish to avoid common Facebook ad mistakes, our team at Impossible Marketing can help you with that!

You can be assured that you are in safe hands when you come to us.
